entities.summary: Robert du Parc (b. 1889-04-27, Klagenfurt am Wörthersee) was a musician or composer of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee and Italy. Known in the fields of italy, painters & sculptors, europe.
